formulaIdentity.fingerprintMethod: sha256 of packet canonicalInci joined with ', '
formulaIdentity.sourceTier: frozen packet canonical INCI (tier not stated in packet); positioning sources retailer only
formulaIdentity.completeness: treated as complete canonical capture (ID-1); no material conflict

cleansingStrength.rationale: Moderate by C1: defining anionic is Sodium Laureth Sulfate (2, ether type), buffered by prominent Cocamidopropyl Betaine (4), no prominent reinforcing anionic. TEA-Dodecylbenzenesulfonate (18) is a strong sulfonate but sits after Parfum (7), so per C4 it is recorded only. Counter-signals toward strong: that late sulfonate, hydrotrope Sodium Xylenesulfonate (3, C3 not a route) and no refatting; they lower confidence to moderate (N-ALT neighbor strong), not the value.

conditioningLevel.rationale: One meaningful conditioning system: Dimethiconol (10), Guar Hydroxypropyltrimonium Chloride (11), Dimethicone (14) coacervate route, all after Parfum (7); Panthenol (19) and Niacinamide (30) late. C2 not met (silicone not prominent, no pearlizing/fatty route), so not high. Counter-signal toward low: every conditioning ingredient is post-fragrance.

excluded: Citrus Aurantium Peel Oil (24): essential/fragrance oil (6.4)
Menthol (12), Hexamethylindanopyran (13) and fragrance allergens: fragrance/cooling materials

depositionLoad.rationale: Two silicones plus a cationic guar form a classic coacervate deposition system; all post-fragrance, so not high.

persistence.rationale: Dimethiconol/dimethicone are persistent silicone routes; no rich lipid or film system adds to them.

resetCapacity.rationale: C1 moderate SLES/betaine chassis; late sulfonate adds little; no clarifying architecture.

weightPotential.counterevidence: All deposition families sit after Parfum (7); no amodimethicone, no lipid; moderate reset.
weightPotential.whyThisBand: A silicone/guar coacervate system is one meaningfully persistent system; with moderate reset it plausibly leaves noticeable but bounded residue.
weightPotential.whyNotNeighborBand: Not low: two distinct deposition families (silicone + cationic guar) form one depositing system, so calling it lightweight would understate residue risk (W2). Not high: no rich architecture (no payload lipid, W-RICH), positions post-fragrance, reset not limited.
weightPotential.confidenceLimitingFactor: Silicone type/molecular weight and guar charge density unknown from INCI; could move it one band toward low.
weightPotential.rationale: Moderate: silicone + cationic guar deposition system (10, 11, 14) against a moderate C1 reset. W1 not applied (no amodimethicone; full 6.6 method used).

careDirection.limitation: No protein/damage-care cluster; generic conditioning only.

focusPrimary.counterSignal: Retailer copy mentions strengthening fine, weak hair and reducing breakage (repair-adjacent), but it is retailer-only (CL-SRC low) and the formula verdict is nonspecific.
focusPrimary.decisionTrace: Dominant claim (name 'Grow Abundance', anti-Haarverlust, denser hair) is hair loss/growth/density -> ignored (F5). Remaining in-scope claim (stärkt, verringert Haarbruch) is retailer-only, graded low; a low claim can be a candidate only if the formula independently supports repair, which it does not (nonspecific). Fallback general.
focusPrimary.rationale: General by F5 and CL-SRC: only out-of-scope hair-loss positioning plus low-graded retailer strengthening copy over a nonspecific formula.

focusSecondary.decisionTrace: Empty default considered; no distinct moderate/high-graded secondary positioning with an independent route.

usageRole.decisionTrace: Default regular. 'regelmäßig' is not U2 frequency wording. treatment checked: dandruffSupport supported but no E2 dandruff claim (U3) -> not fired. No reset intent, cleansing not strong.
usageRole.rationale: Regular: no non-default trigger fires (U2, U3).

scalpComfortTarget.rationale: No E2 sensitive or dry claim unit; 'reinigt die Formel sanft' is mildness (SC1). Menthol (12) is a counter-signal; Panthenol (19)/Niacinamide (30) late.

projection.thicknessRationale: T1 with W moderate, C moderate: fine acceptable, normal ideal, coarse acceptable (C not high). Ordinary target, no T6. T4: W neighbor low would raise fine to ideal and keep normal ideal; C neighbor low keeps coarse acceptable; no lower tier -> no flag.
projection.scalpTargetRationale: S-ORDINARY ways 2 and 3: only scalp-adjacent positioning is hair loss/root strengthening (S-HAIRLOSS) and Piroctone Olamine is present without a dandruff claim (S-DANDRUFF note). Confidence moderate (13.8, ways 2-4).
projection.cleansingIntensityRationale: I1: cleansingStrength moderate -> regular. I3: neighbor strong with usageRole regular -> regular, still matches the normal bucket's regular -> no flag.
projection.deepCleanserRationale: D1 false (no D1 lexicon term); D2 not met.

uncertainties: All positioning sources are retailer copy (CL-SRC low); no manufacturer page in the packet.
S-ORDINARY is reached by both way 2 (hair loss) and way 3 (active without dandruff claim); both are named.
Weight low vs moderate depends on silicone/guar levels after Parfum.
